STAGE 1

Write the whole-module specification

InputClean RTL module: autovcoder_024510.v
InstructionDescribe the whole module’s interface and observable behavior in self-contained prose.

Protocol summary; exact prompt wording is retained by the evaluation runner, not this historical import.

OutputGenerated whole-module specification (prose).
Read input: autovcoder_024510.v · Open raw
module autovcoder_024510 (
    data,
    data_l,
    decodeout_l
);

  input [3:0] data, data_l;
  output [15:0] decodeout_l;


  wire [3:0] sel, bottom;
  //wire [15:0] decodeout_l;


  // decode top order bits

  decode2to4 decodeupper (
      .datain  (data[3:2]),
      .datain_l(data_l[3:2]),
      .dataout (sel[3:0])
  );

  // decode lower order bits

  decode2to4 decodelower (
      .datain  (data[1:0]),
      .datain_l(data_l[1:0]),
      .dataout (bottom[3:0])
  );

  // now use the top order bits to select the proper lower order bits


  finalsel4 finalsel4_3 (
      .sel (~sel[3]),
      .data(~bottom[3:0]),
      .out (decodeout_l[15:12])
  );

  finalsel4 finalsel4_2 (
      .sel (~sel[2]),
      .data(~bottom[3:0]),
      .out (decodeout_l[11:8])
  );

  finalsel4 finalsel4_1 (
      .sel (~sel[1]),
      .data(~bottom[3:0]),
      .out (decodeout_l[7:4])
  );

  finalsel4 finalsel4_0 (
      .sel (~sel[0]),
      .data(~bottom[3:0]),
      .out (decodeout_l[3:0])
  );


endmodule
